mappings.rationale: Values are business names (e.g. 'SMEC Australia Pty Ltd') in a contract disclosure where the supplier is a business. Assumption: this is the as-registered name, but the source does not confirm registration; flagged as an assumption. Confidence set at threshold because the mapping is plausible but unverified against a register.
Header explicitly names supplier ABN, validated by abn checksum transform. Column is empty in the 4 sample rows (only 1 of 700 nonempty in training), so coverage is minimal.

Values in samples are 4-digit numeric codes (4006, 3149, 4000), consistent with Australian postcodes. Header says 'address' but values are postcodes only, not a full address; mapped to postcode, not address.full.

warnings: Supplier name is a business name from a procurement disclosure; mapping to entity.legal_name is an assumption (not confirmed as registered name). Consider manual verification before treating as legal name.

Source has no supplier-level observation date; observed_at_field is null. The provided observed_at (2026-09-21) is a resource last-modified proxy, not a source statement time, so it must not be used as observed_at.
Supplier address contains postcodes only; no locality, state, or full address is mapped. address.state is not inferable from the column and is left unmapped.
Supplier ABN is empty in the 700-record training sample except for one row; checksum validation will reject invalid values. ACN is not present and must not be inferred from ABN.
Supplier name is single-valued per row in the samples; no compound or multi-supplier fields detected. If compound names appear in other rows, they must be left unmapped.

entity.trading_name, entity.entity_type, entity.status, entity.date_registered, entity.industry_code, entity.website, entity.nzbn, entity.acn, address.full, address.locality, address.state, and address.country are not supported by any source column and are not mapped.
Agency (buyer) identifiers and addresses are excluded from supplier mapping.
